about_the_game:
The Creator: Immerse Yourself in the World of Design


The Creator is a simulation game where you become a design master, creating stylish and cozy spaces in the most picturesque corners of the world. No limits, no stress — just creativity and inspiration!


Design Master


Use a variety of decor elements, furniture, plants, and landscape features to create unique interior and exterior designs.
Choose styles, colors, and materials to your liking, filling locations with an atmosphere of comfort and harmony.


Location Variety


Customize cozy city apartments and residential homes of all kinds.
Garages and various rooms offer space for your unique ideas.
Enhance the setting with comfortable rest areas and functional elements.
Thousands of items await to be part of your design projects.


Creativity and Immersion


Forget about resource hunting and constraints — focus entirely on beauty creation.
Experiment freely, enjoying the process and finding perfect solutions.
Realistic day-night cycles and diverse weather conditions — from sunny days to thunderstorms with lightning — add depth and expressiveness to your creations.
Capture stunning photos of your projects with a customizable photo mode featuring various filters.
Share your best shots with friends and the gaming community, drawing inspiration from others’ work.

name: The Creator

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel or AMD processor, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 470 GTX or AMD Radeon 6870 HD series card or higher
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel or AMD processor, 3.0 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 970 GTX or AMD Radeon 570 HD series card or higher
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: The Creator is a peaceful meditative game-simulator where you create unique designs for locations and territories. Enjoy the creative process without searching for resources or fear of making mistakes, as you design stunning interiors and exteriors in picturesque corners of the world.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil
